week_ending.label: Week ending
week_ending.definition: Friday reference date of the EIA storage series.

period_start.label: Period start
period_start.definition: First calendar day in the weather and spot sampling window (the preceding Friday).

period_end.label: Period end
period_end.definition: Last calendar day in the sampling window (Thursday before the storage Friday).

working_gas_bcf.label: Working gas
working_gas_bcf.definition: Lower 48 working gas inventory, billion cubic feet.

change_bcf.label: Weekly change
change_bcf.definition: Current working gas inventory less inventory on the prior Friday. An injection is positive. A withdrawal is negative.

hdd.label: Heating degree days
hdd.definition: Weekly sum of population-weighted heating degree days from NOAA CPC, 65°F base.

cdd.label: Cooling degree days
cdd.definition: Weekly sum of population-weighted cooling degree days from NOAA CPC, 65°F base.

spot_avg_usd_mmbtu.label: Mean spot
spot_avg_usd_mmbtu.definition: Arithmetic mean of the Henry Hub daily spot quotes published within the seven-day window, rounded to four decimal places.

spot_days.label: Spot quotes
spot_days.definition: Count of reported daily spot prices inside the sampling window. Unreported dates receive no weight.

date.label: Quote date
date.definition: Calendar date of the observed Henry Hub spot quote.

usd_per_mmbtu.label: Henry Hub spot
usd_per_mmbtu.definition: Henry Hub natural gas spot price in U.S. dollars per million British thermal units.

weekly.label: Joined weekly
weekly.about: One row per EIA storage Friday. Weather and spot refer to the preceding Friday through Thursday.

storage.label: Working gas storage
storage.about: Working gas in underground storage for the Lower 48. A positive weekly change is a net injection.

weather.label: Heating and cooling
weather.about: Contiguous U.S. population-weighted degree days, aggregated from NOAA observations for a seven-day period.

spot.label: Henry Hub spot
spot.about: Reported Henry Hub spot price in U.S. dollars per million British thermal units. Dates with no quote are absent.

release_note: Snapshot dates are observation dates. Historical records reflect the current source files and may include revisions.
